listing.summary: Experimental project. steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own 1080° Snowboarding Nintendo 64 JU revision 0 ROM. Check the required size and SHA-1 in games/1080-us/profile.toml before importing. Keep the original separately. These instructions do not download or run it.

warnings: Only a partial Nintendo 64 logo has been established in Debug and Release builds. Menus and riding are unverified. A complete playthrough has not been confirmed, and results from another game do not establish that this one works. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
